notes: • Stellwerk for Mac: Claude chats can use Claude in Chrome again, as they could in Conductor. Settings → Agents → Claude in Chrome turns it on (on by default when the Claude extension is installed in Chrome or another Chromium browser), and the row says whether the extension was found. Chats that are running switch after their turn and keep their history. With it off, Claude tells you where to turn it on instead of quietly having no browser tools.
